Thanks for helping improve Riottosa.

Before submitting an issue, please check whether the same or a similar problem has already been reported.

## Description

Please describe the problem as clearly as possible.

## Where does the issue occur?

Please specify whether the issue concerns:

- the typeface or font files;
- glyph design;
- spacing or kerning;
- interpolation or variable axes;
- the website/specimen;
- documentation;
- something else.

## Glyphs or characters involved

If applicable, please specify the glyphs, characters, words, or character combinations involved.

## Font settings

If applicable, please indicate the Weight and Width settings where the problem occurs.

## Environment

Please provide any relevant information, such as:

- operating system;
- application or browser;
- font format or version.

## Steps to reproduce

Please describe how the problem can be reproduced.

## Expected result

What did you expect to happen?

## Screenshots or examples

If useful, please attach screenshots or other visual examples.

## Additional information

Add any other information that may help understand the issue.
